issues.title: Let members pick a reminder time
issues.body: Some members would like the reminder in the evening instead of at night.

issues.title: Overdue emails say how many days overdue the loan is
issues.body:
## Context
Members at the desk say the weekly overdue email reads the same every week, so they can't tell a new reminder from an old one. The email should say how long the loan has been overdue.

## Scope
In: the body of the overdue email that `sendReminders` builds in `src/reminders.js`.
Out: when reminders are sent, and letting members pick a reminder time (#13).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given a loan 7 or more days overdue, when the nightly job emails about it, the body ends with the line `This loan is N days overdue.`, where N is the whole days since the due date (7, 14, ...).
- [ ] Given a loan less than a full day overdue (the first email), the body has no days-overdue line.
- [ ] The subject stays `Overdue: <title>`.
- [ ] After the next deploy, the 02:00 cron run on the library VPS sends emails with the new line (check the outbox log on the server).

## Definition of done
- [ ] Tests for every acceptance criterion
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed
